policy.bundling: Bundle font bytes only when redistribution is confirmed and include the corresponding license text.
policy.resolution: Prefer an official pinned download URL with a required SHA-256. A configured local source is acceptable only when its SHA-256 matches this manifest.
policy.gsap: Do not bundle GSAP here. Resolve the pinned 3.14.2 distribution URL and verify its recorded SHA-256 under the GreenSock Standard License.

fonts.verification: The bundled bytes retain the exact hash used by the approved render. The embedded font metadata and Google Fonts metadata identify the same family, style, copyright holder, and OFL license.
